page_title: ACM 1-0 ROM | AC Milan v AS Roma 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Marco Guida is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
90+5' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Substitution. Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) has come on for Rafael Leao.
90+3' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
90+1' Marco Guida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Evan Ndicka (AS Roma).
90+1' The resulting corner from Leon Bailey (AS Roma) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
88' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) replacing Alexis Saelemaekers.
87' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Guida saw the whole situation.
86' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
85' A lofted cross from Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
85' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
84' The substitution has been made. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) has replaced Paulo Dybala.
84' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Mario Hermoso is replaced by Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma).
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) coming on for Christopher Nkunku.
83' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
82' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

82' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Mike Maignan anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort. The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
82' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

81' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for AS Roma!
78' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
77' Substitution. Zeki Celik did his best and is replaced by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
76' A rebound falls at the feet of Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
75' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
74' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
73' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
72' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
70' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

70' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
70' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will deliver the corner kick.
70' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
69' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

68' The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner. Rafael Leao (AC Milan) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Mile Svilar, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.

68' Mile Svilar pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom left corner, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.

68' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) takes a good first touch from a cross and fires a powerful shot from the edge of the box towards the right post. The goalkeeper, though, is ready and denies him with a brilliant save.
64' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.

63' A neat pass is well received by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
62' Mike Maignan leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).

62' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
59' The resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared.
59' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AS Roma.

57' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Guida with no other option than to blow for a foul.
56' AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
53' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Luka Modric (AC Milan) took the corner.
53' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. AC Milan get a corner.

52' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Mile Svilar has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
52' The game has come to an end for Neil El Aynaoui. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
51' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Leon Bailey (AS Roma) replaces Matias Soule.

51' Half-chance! Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Mile Svilar reacts well to snuff out the attack. The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick. The linesman raises his flag for offside before Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) heads on.
50' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the left post and ricochets away!
50' Luka Modric (AC Milan) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

49' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Mile Svilar is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AC Milan.
47' Mile Svilar pulls off a great save to deny Rafael Leao (AC Milan) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
46' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Marco Guida has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
44' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Mile Svilar is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
42' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.

39' 1 - 0 Goal Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan)! Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) was put through by Rafael Leao and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
38' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the corner which is cleared.

37' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Rough tackle by Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Wesley Franca floats in a cross for Evan Ndicka (AS Roma), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the right post.
35' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Guida blows for a foul.
35' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Guida has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
33' Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
32' Wesley Franca plays a pass into the path of Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
29' Matias Soule (AS Roma) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
29' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
28' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. AS Roma win a free kick.
27' The corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is intercepted by Mile Svilar.
27' The ball is cleared after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
24' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

23' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Marco Guida couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) and blew his whistle.
23' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) sends a long cross over to Rafael Leao, but Mile Svilar comes forward to gather the ball.
20' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post.
20' Now AC Milan have a corner.
20' AC Milan will take a corner kick. Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
20' The ball is laid off to Wesley Franca (AS Roma) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Mike Maignan to make a decent save.
19' Matias Soule (AS Roma) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
17' Zeki Celik dinks a lofted pass into the path of Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) inside the box, but his drive sails a whisker past the right post.
16' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mike Maignan is quickest to intercept the ball.
16' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

15' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Mike Maignan shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
13' It looks like Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) saw red with that tackle. Marco Guida won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
12' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
10' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
9' The game is interrupted. Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
8' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Guida interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
7' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Mike Maignan gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
3' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.

1' Nice move, nice attempt! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Guida.
